# Release Notes: July 6, 2026

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience.

## Fixes

### Geographic Validation Fix in Network360

Resolved an issue where valid ZIP codes were incorrectly excluded from population file uploads. The import process now ensures any ZIP with contracted providers is included in the reference data.

### Radius Search Stability in Compare Networks

Fixed "state is invalid" error that occurred during radius searches of 21+ miles. The system now gracefully handles missing state mappings in backend lookup data to prevent report failures.

### Bulk ZIP Search Improvements in Network360

Fixed a bug where a single invalid ZIP code in a bulk list would prevent all selectable networks from appearing. The system now displays networks for valid ZIPs and provides clear error messages for invalid ones.

### Export Button Fix in Disruption

Resolved an issue where special characters (like backticks (‘)) in file headers would disable export buttons. Export functionality is now fully operational regardless of header formatting.

### Navigation Reliability in Disruption

Fixed the browser Back and Forward buttons to work correctly even when a user encounters an "Invalid Analysis" or error page within the Disruption module.
